profile.headline: In stealth mode startup
profile.summary:
Language: C#, C/C++, Java

Academic Projects:
Topic Models for Graduation Project
  ● Developed distributed WLDA topic model using Hadoop and Amazon EC2 in Java and Python
Pictorial and Multimedia Database
  ● Implemented the Android mobile application that estimates age of people from pictures in Java 
Web Information Management
   ● Simulated Topic Modeling to find periodic issues from a great deal of news articles in Python
  Advanced Networking 
   ● Participated in implementing a part of Smart Grid with Attribute Based Encryption in Java
  DB system and programming
   ● Implemented the Web application for showing the information of the records which indicates
   ability of players and statistics of results of games in ASP, Javascript and Yahoo User Interface 
  Design of Game Software
   ● Participated in developing a simple first-person airplane shooting game based on OpenGL in C
  Image Processing
   ● Developed an image processing application which recognizes people’s faces on video in MFC
  Modeling Analysis and Simulation
   ● Simulated image processing by Fourier Transform in C++, MATLAB

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer in Excel [C++, C#, C]
● Developed new features for Excel such as Data types and styles for them
● Analyzed big user telemetry data and created report by using Kusto
● Involved projects to bring shared core code for all different platforms
● Implemented reading AR chart on Hackathon for Android by using OpenCV

positions.title: Technology Developer and Analyst
positions.description:
Software Developer [C#, C++]
● Designing secure framework to extract, convert, and analyze mortgage related data
● Developing data quality process to ensure a 99.99% reliability index on job performance
● Implemented a multi-threaded application to improve data quality performance

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Web Application Developer 
       ● Implemented a tool for using the new Content Delivery Network(CDN) library in C#
       ● Developed applications to check for database faults in C# and JQuery

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
● Implemented an E-Document application for tablets in JQuery, HTML5, CSS3, ASP.NET, C#
● Applied Web Sockets and Backbone.js to the application on client and server side in Javascript

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Java Developer
● Engaged in developing Eclipse Plug-in for IDE of the Web Framework
● Implemented an application to send mass e-mails to customers
● Involved in developing the Web Framework based on MVC in Java and JSP
 Web Developer
● Implemented the company website in ASP, PHP and connected it to the customer database in
 order to allow customers to send free text messages and to check their contract status 
● Developed collaborative software in ASP and JSP connected it to the infrastructure database
